application.label: Application
application.description: Deploy one app from Git and keep it in sync.

fields.label: Application name
fields.description: A name for this Application. It must be unique in the Argo CD namespace.

fields.label: Argo CD namespace
fields.description: The namespace Argo CD watches, usually argocd.

fields.label: Project
fields.description: The AppProject that sets which Git repositories and namespaces this app may use.

fields.label: Git repository URL
fields.description: The Git repository that holds your Kubernetes files.

fields.label: Git revision
fields.description: The branch, tag, or commit to deploy. A commit ID pins one exact version.

fields.label: Path in repository
fields.description: The folder in the repository that holds the files.

fields.label: Destination server
fields.description: Address of the cluster to deploy to. The default means the cluster Argo CD runs in.

fields.label: Destination namespace
fields.description: Namespace for app objects that do not set their own.

fields.label: Create destination namespace
fields.description: Create the namespace during sync if it is missing. The AppProject must allow Namespace objects.

fields.label: Automated sync
fields.description: Apply Git changes automatically instead of waiting for a manual sync.

fields.label: Prune removed resources
fields.description: With automated sync, delete objects that were removed from Git.

fields.label: Self-heal
fields.description: With automated sync, undo manual changes so the cluster matches Git again.

fields.label: Delete managed resources with the Application
fields.description: Deleting the Application also deletes the objects it deployed.

app-project.label: AppProject
app-project.description: Limit where Applications can deploy and which Git repository they can use.

fields.label: Project name
fields.description: A name for this AppProject. It must be unique in the Argo CD namespace.

fields.label: Argo CD namespace
fields.description: The namespace Argo CD watches, usually argocd.

fields.label: Allowed repository URL
fields.description: The Git repository that Applications in this project may use.

fields.label: Allowed destination server
fields.description: Address of the cluster these Applications may deploy to.

fields.label: Allowed destination namespace
fields.description: The namespace these Applications may deploy to.

application-set.label: ApplicationSet
application-set.description: Create one Application per environment from a single template. Needs the ApplicationSet controller running.

fields.label: ApplicationSet name
fields.description: A name for this ApplicationSet. It must be unique in the Argo CD namespace.

fields.label: Argo CD namespace
fields.description: The namespace Argo CD watches, usually argocd.

fields.label: Project
fields.description: The AppProject that sets which Git repositories and namespaces these apps may use.

fields.label: First environment
fields.description: Added to the name of the first Application, such as dev.

fields.label: Second environment
fields.description: Added to the name of the second Application, such as staging.

fields.label: Git repository URL
fields.description: The Git repository that holds your Kubernetes files.

fields.label: Git revision
fields.description: The branch, tag, or commit to deploy. A commit ID pins one exact version.

fields.label: Path in repository
fields.description: The folder in the repository that holds the files.

fields.label: Destination server
fields.description: Address of the cluster to deploy to. The default means the cluster Argo CD runs in.

fields.label: Destination namespace pattern
fields.description: Namespace for each app. {{ .environment }} becomes each environment name.
